name: holdout-panel-intros
description: A panel where the host introduces each speaker in the third person before they speak.
lines: Welcome everyone. Our first speaker is Priya Shah, who leads design at a fintech startup. Priya, over to you.
Thank you. I want to talk about what we learned rebuilding our onboarding from scratch.
Thanks Priya. Next we have Sam Patel from the payments team. Sam, the floor's yours.
Thanks. I'll pick up where Priya left off and talk about the payments side of onboarding.
